name: AutoPay Workflow Project
description: An internal project to automate the accounts payable workflow using AI-based invoice processing and approval routing. The system will handle $12M in monthly payments, integrate with our ERP (SAP), and use an LLM to classify and auto-approve invoices under $5,000. The project is delivered by a 2-person internal team with a hard 90-day deadline. No formal change management, risk assessment, or UAT process has been defined. The system will have direct write access to payment initiation tables.
